name: NY-14
label: Safe D

key_factors: Ocasio-Cortez's massive financial advantage ($32.6M raised vs $0.3M)
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~96%
model.rationale: The D+19 district, a well-funded incumbent with a national profile, and a Republican opponent who has raised only about $343,000 all point to a decisive Democratic win, and markets agree at roughly 96%. No polls or expert ratings contradict the fundamentals.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or an unexpectedly strong Republican fundraising surge would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez seeks another term in a New York City district that leans Democratic by about 19 points. She has raised more than $32 million and holds over $15 million in cash, while Republican Diamant Hysenaj has raised roughly $343,000 with minimal cash on hand. No outside groups are spending against the incumbent, and no independent polls of the race are available.

Prediction markets give the Democrat about a 96 percent chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals and the lopsided financial picture. With no credible evidence of a competitive race, this sits firmly in Safe D territory, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty about the exact margin.
